s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision loss with chorioretinal atrophy and scleral ectasia
salient_findings: Yellowish oval lesion within a wide area of chorioretinal atrophy
Ringlike low reflectance pattern on infrared examination
Focal scleral ectasia with no overlying retina on spectral-domain optical coherence tomography
key_facts: Patient has high myopia
Axial length is 30.0 mm
Ophthalmoscopic examination revealed a yellowish oval lesion
Chorioretinal atrophy is present
Infrared examination showed a ringlike low reflectance pattern
Spectral-domain optical coherence tomography revealed a focal scleral ectasia
Sclera is approximately one-third thinner at the pit's floor, temporal wall, and nasal wall
Choroid is obliterated
Pit has a homogeneous low autofluorescence
Fluorescein angiography showed a branch of a posterior ciliary artery near the lesion
Pit is slightly hyperfluorescent in the late frames

shortlist.label: Pathologic myopia
shortlist.why_kept: High myopia with axial length of 30.0 mm and chorioretinal atrophy

shortlist.label: Posterior staphyloma
shortlist.why_kept: Focal scleral ectasia with chorioretinal atrophy and thinning of the sclera

shortlist.label: Choroidal neovascularization
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a branch of a posterior ciliary artery near the lesion and hyperfluorescence in late frames

shortlist.label: Central areolar choroidal dystrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Chorioretinal atrophy and scleral ectasia with a ringlike low reflectance pattern

shortlist.label: Gyrate atrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Chorioretinal atrophy and scleral ectasia with a focal lesion

raw.rationale: The patient's high myopia, axial length of 30.0 mm, and presence of chorioretinal atrophy are consistent with pathologic myopia. The focal scleral ectasia and obliterated choroid also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Posterior staphyloma
rejected.why: While posterior staphyloma can be associated with pathologic myopia, it is not a specific diagnosis that explains all the key facts.

rejected.label: Choroidal neovascularization
rejected.why: There is no evidence of new blood vessel growth or leakage on fluorescein angiography to support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Central areolar choroidal dystrophy
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with a well-defined area of atrophy in the macula, which is not described in the vignette.

rejected.label: Gyrate atrophy
rejected.why: This condition is characterized by a specific pattern of atrophy that starts in the periphery and progresses centrally, which is not consistent with the described lesion.
